preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 2013.
The length of the string S for each test case must be between 1 and 2013.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S must be a capital letter from 'A' to 'Z' or a question mark '?'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest string obtained by replacing all question marks in S with capital letters.
The output string must contain the maximum possible number of substrings equal to 'CHEF'.

postconditions.expression: result == min(result for result in possible_results)
postconditions.description: If multiple strings can achieve the maximum count of 'CHEF', the output must be the lexicographically smallest one.
